metadata.coverage_preamble: Today holds the hill, the brook, the bridge, and the tub.

yesterday: From Sun Rising Hill the Vale lay out, and the spire was a pin in the haze.
You sat at the brook below Ettington with both feet in the water. The heel was bound in a strip of shirt. You shaved by feel.
Judith walks as you walk, and she means your father. Hamnet has a hundred, and Susanna looked at your feet.
At the town end of the bridge Richard took the pack. The flat parcel rides on top.
Anne wrote stay away, and the letter also said come for harvest. You told her the horse was dear, and she dressed two burst blisters.
